column1: 1. In a wok, add cooking oil, chunjang, and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Stir-fry over medium-low heat for 10 minutes.
2. Remove the chunjang from the wok and set it aside. Stir-fry some onion and pork over high heat.
3. Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, onion, and zucchini to the wok and stir-fry over high heat.
4. Add 1 tablespoon of oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon of sugar, a pinch of MSG, a little water, and a pinch of starch.
5. Garnish with a fried egg and cucumber.
6. Boil the frozen Chinese noodles for 40 seconds.
